title: 自我呈现简表（KSE-G，6题）

references.title: An English-Language Adaptation of the Social Desirability–Gamma Short Scale (KSE-G)
references.journal: Measurement Instruments for the Social Sciences

instructions.en: The following statements may apply more or less to you personally. Please indicate to what extent they apply to you.
instructions.zh: 下面这些说法与你的实际情况可能有不同程度的符合。请指出每句话与你有多符合。

items.en: In an argument, I always remain objective and stick to the facts.
items.zh: 争论时，我总能保持客观、就事论事。

items.en: Even if I am feeling stressed, I am always friendly and polite to others.
items.zh: 即使感到压力，我也总是友好、有礼貌地对待别人。

items.en: When talking to someone, I always listen carefully to what the other person says.
items.zh: 与人交谈时，我总是认真听对方说话。

items.en: It has happened that I have taken advantage of someone in the past.
items.zh: 过去我曾占过别人的便宜。

items.en: I have occasionally thrown litter away in the countryside or on to the road.
items.zh: 我偶尔曾在郊外或路上乱扔垃圾。

items.en: Sometimes I only help people if I expect to get something in return.
items.zh: 有时，只有觉得会得到回报，我才帮助别人。

subscales.higherMeans: Stronger agreement with always displaying positive conduct; not proof of exaggeration or dishonesty.
More endorsement of the stated negative acts, NOT greater denial or minimization.

scoring.directionWarning: The author labels the second construct minimizing negative qualities, but publishes raw item/subscale means around 1.90/2.12 and instructs unweighted means without reversal. Preserve raw scoring; do not label a high raw mean as more concealment. Do not silently reverse to create a global desirability score.
scoring.originalGermanCodingWarning: English 2019 uses 1–5; German 2014 used 0–4. Do not mix reference values or coding.

referenceUse: Supplementary Table S1 raw means, context only. Not honesty thresholds, cross-cultural norms, or exclusion criteria.

report.title: 描述自己时，你看见了哪些面？
report.intro: 我们介绍自己时，往往更容易想到做得好的地方；有些不太理想的小事，也可能不容易承认。这份简表邀请你留意这种表达习惯，不是测谎仪，更不是“好人分数”。
report.explanation: 前半部分谈的是“我总能做到”的好表现，后半部分谈的是偶尔出现的不理想行为。它们分开看，不合成一张诚信成绩单。回答也会受到当时心情、题目理解和作答场合的影响。
report.lifeExample: 比如，工作汇报时你可能先说顺利完成的任务；和熟悉的朋友复盘时，却更容易提起一次拖延。这不一定是撒谎，场合和安全感也会影响我们怎样介绍自己。
actions: 看到“总是”这样的词时，想一个最近的具体例子，再问问自己有没有例外。
写下“这次做得不错的一件事”和“下次想改进的一件事”，让两种观察同时存在。
若需要和别人讨论结果，先说清楚：这不是判断诚实程度的证据，也不应该用来决定谁值得信任。
report.caveat: 这份中文工作译稿尚未经过本土验证。不能据此认定隐瞒、撒谎或作答无效，也不能自动删除研究参与者的数据。
